_note: FR-FOOD-6: common North and South Indian home dishes as standard recipes. Nutrients per 100 g = sum of the ingredients' USDA nutrients ÷ cooked yield. Yield = total recipe grams × (1 − loss); loss is the water that cooks off (defaults per kind in lossByKind). Recipes are typical home versions, so values are estimates. IFCT 2017 has no open licence we could find, so it isn't used. Ingredients map to USDA SR Legacy ids (sr) or FNDDS ids (fndds); water has no nutrients. Poha (flattened rice) uses raw white rice, which is nutritionally close.

paneer._note: Proxy: SR Legacy 'Cheese, mozzarella, whole milk' (299 kcal, 22 g protein, 22 g fat, 2 g carbs per 100 g) is close to fresh paneer. FNDDS 'Cheese, paneer' (fdc 2705740) lists 22.5 g carbs per 100 g, which is not plausible for paneer (D110).
